edges.reason: _initialAmount flows into the constructor to set balances and totalSupply.
_tokenName flows into the constructor assignment of name.
_decimalUnits flows into the constructor assignment of decimals.
_tokenSymbol flows into the constructor assignment of symbol.
_owner parameter flows into the constructor ownership assignment.
_lockedAddress drives the constructor loop writing lockedBalances.
_lockedBalances supplies amounts written into lockedBalances.
_lockedTimes supplies lock times written into lockedBalances.
_to parameter is the transfer recipient.
_value parameter is the transfer amount.
_who parameter selects the account to burn from.
_value parameter is the burn amount.
_value parameter is the mint amount.
_owner parameter selects the address queried by balanceOf.
_to parameter is directly used as the external transfer recipient in withdrawTo.
Loop counter i controls the constructor locked-balance initialization loop.
success is the boolean returned by transfer.
balance is the value returned by balanceOf.

transfer reads and updates balances for sender and recipient without safe math.
burnFrom decreases balances[_who] with unchecked arithmetic.
burnFrom decreases totalSupply with unchecked arithmetic.
burnFrom clears the locked balance entry of _who.
makeCoin increases totalSupply with unchecked arithmetic.
makeCoin increases balances[owner] with unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf reads balances.
msg.sender determines which balance and lock state transfer acts on.
burnFrom is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
makeCoin is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
withdraw is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
withdrawTo is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
block.timestamp (now) selects the locked balance branch in transfer.
transfer performs unchecked subtraction on balances[msg.sender].
transfer performs unchecked addition on balances[_to].
burnFrom performs unchecked subtraction on totalSupply.
burnFrom performs unchecked subtraction on balances[_who].
makeCoin performs unchecked addition on totalSupply.
makeCoin performs unchecked addition on balances[owner].
withdraw makes an external call to msg.sender after gaining owner privileges.
withdrawTo makes an external call to a caller-supplied address.

normalization_plan.reason: _initialAmount is a constructor parameter whose only effect is initializing state inside the constructor.
_tokenName is a constructor parameter written to name inside the constructor.
_decimalUnits is a constructor parameter written to decimals inside the constructor.
_tokenSymbol is a constructor parameter written to symbol inside the constructor.
_owner constructor parameter flows directly into the owner state assignment.
_lockedAddress is consumed entirely by the constructor loop writing lockedBalances.
_lockedBalances is consumed entirely by the constructor locked balance initialization.
_lockedTimes is consumed entirely by the constructor locked time initialization.
_to is the recipient parameter of transfer and directly shapes its balance updates.
_value is the amount parameter of transfer and directly feeds its arithmetic operations.
_who is the account parameter of burnFrom and directly feeds its balance updates.
_value is the amount parameter of burnFrom and directly feeds its arithmetic operations.
_value is the amount parameter of makeCoin and directly feeds its mint arithmetic.
_owner is the address parameter of balanceOf used only for the lookup.
_to is the recipient parameter of withdrawTo and flows straight into the external transfer call.
i is a loop counter local to the constructor locked balance initialization.
success is the returned local flag of transfer and has no independent semantics.
balance is the returned local value of balanceOf and has no independent semantics.
